svg.title: Activity — Mohd Ayaan
svg.desc: Left: the six most recent public GitHub events, each with date, event type, repository and detail — pushes, a merged pull request, comments on upstream pull requests, and a new branch, including work in the upstream ArviZ repositories. Right: a heat grid of the GitHub contribution calendar, 53 weeks by 7 days, totalling 126 contributions in the last twelve months: 97 commits, 10 pull requests and 1 issue opened.
